name: menghuan
description: 梦幻（Menghuan）阶段3最小领域模型、PostgreSQL Schema与Repository统一边界。

scripts.dev:web: pnpm --filter @menghuan/domain build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/database build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @menghuan/domain build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/database build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/sync-worker build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @menghuan/domain build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @menghuan/database build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/sync-worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @menghuan/web typecheck
scripts.test:database: pnpm --filter @menghuan/domain build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/database build && vitest run --config vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @menghuan/domain build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/database build && playwright test
scripts.health:worker: pnpm --silent --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --silent --filter @menghuan/sync-worker exec tsx src/cli/health.ts
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @menghuan/domain build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/database db:migrate
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @menghuan/domain build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/config build && pnpm --filter @menghuan/database db:seed
